early_boot_services.VISION.BEX: Owns private server ABI; client wrappers must not call back into the provider.
early_boot_services.PRINTSPL.BEX: Spooler owns execution; PRINT.LBS remains its client.
early_boot_services.SCREENSV.BEX: Service lifecycle and trusted ABI remain separate.

compatibility: Linux/Wine use their existing ABI; native LBS are not replacements for Linux SO.

self_contained_installers.extras/quake2/INSTALL.BEX: Can repair/install from older native systems without requiring the runtime it is installing.

civilization_port: Local source is Freeciv 3.2.5, not a directory named Civ2; preserve original client/server program names.
source_inventory: tests/lbs/evidence/total/local-extras-inventory.json records additional ports and original/prototype sources, outside the initial extra application manifest.
